title: Kinyarwanda Pancakes
description: A delicious and fluffy pancake recipe inspired by the flavors of Kinyarwanda, a traditional Rwandan dish. These pancakes are perfect for breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: 2 cups all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: can be replaced with gluten-free flour

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the vanilla extract to the wet ingredients and whisk until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
The batter should still be slightly lumpy.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings, such as syrup, fresh fruit, or whipped cream.
